name: hotfix-developer
title: Hotfix developer
description: Every 30 minutes (07:17-23:47): when a priority: critical issue has a maintainer's agent-ready or ready label and no pull request yet, develops it now by running the installed issue-developer prompt for critical issues only; otherwise ends in seconds.
notes: Needs the issue-developer routine installed: it reads the installed issue-developer SKILL.md (tasks_dir, task_prefix + issue-developer) and follows it. The gate (bin/sentinel-scan --gate develop) uses sentinel.json. Skills are the ones the issue-developer prompt calls.
